subject: OneTrust: evidence lifecycle retrofit + allowed upload options
messages:
From: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@finops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OneTrust onboarding — evidence lifecycle and uploads

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Two items popped up in our onboarding checklist that we want to clarify before we complete the profile in OneTrust:

1) Evidence lifecycle: we need to know how Redwood intends to version and rotate evidence artifacts in OneTrust. Our compliance team expects clear retention timestamps and a changelog for any replacement artifacts (especially for SOC2 reports and encryption proof).

2) Upload channel: FinOps' security ops prefers S3-hosted presigned links for bulk evidence ingestion (we use automated ingestion to pull artifacts). Does Redwood allow us to host attachments off-portal and provide presigned URLs, or must everything be uploaded directly into OneTrust?

If possible, can you send a compact inventory (CSV or short list) of current evidence items you plan to publish to the portal, and the expected rotation cadence? Our timeline is tight — hoping to finalize profile by next Friday.

Appreciate it —
Lisa Turner
Security Programs Lead, FinOps Inc
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@finops.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding — evidence lifecycle and uploads

Hi Lisa —

Really appreciate the clear checklist. Short answers up front:

- Evidence lifecycle: we maintain a canonical evidence index and publish snapshots to OneTrust. We keep the previous two snapshots for audit traceability (current + last two). Every published artifact includes a metadata footer with a UTC timestamp and a semantic version (e.g., soc2-2027-09-v1).

- Upload channel: we can accept presigned S3 links for bulk ingestion (preferred for large bundles), but we also support direct upload through the OneTrust UI for individual docs. We'll provide both options.

I've looped in Irene from Platform Security — she will attach the compact inventory and SOC2 summary and confirm rotation cadence.

Next steps: Irene will drop the CSV inventory and a short note on S3 ACL/expiration expectations. Once you confirm the S3 policy, we can push the initial snapshot into your OneTrust sandbox this week.

Cheers,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@finops.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding — evidence lifecycle and uploads

Hi Lisa / Karthik —

Attached: Redwood_SOC2-2027-summary.pdf (public summary), evidence-index-compact.csv (inventory for OneTrust). Quick notes below.

Inventory highlights (see CSV columns: evidence_id, doc_type, published_at_utc, version_tag, retention_policy_days):
- SOC2 Type II report — published_at_utc: 2027-08-01T00:00:00Z, version: soc2-2027-08-v1, retention_policy_days: 540 (we retain full report PDFs for 18 months in the portal).
- Key rotation proof (KMS logs snapshot) — rotating quarterly, we publish a consolidated quarterly artifact with versioning as kms-q1-2027-v1, etc.
- Pen test attestation — annual; we keep two most recent attestations.

S3 presigned link guidance:
- We can generate presigned PUT URLs that expire in 7 days for the ingestion window. Our automation will set the object ACL to private; OneTrust ingestion will pull using a short-lived role we can provision if you prefer.
- Recommended: 7-day presign + object checksum (sha256) included in the CSV so OneTrust can validate on ingest.

Open question for FinOps: do you need the older artifact lineage retained in OneTrust or is a pointer to our retention log sufficient? We typically publish three artifact snapshots to portal (current + 2 historical) and keep a longer internal archive for 3 years. If you require >3 snapshots in portal, we can extend the publication window but will need to sync on storage/access SLOs.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the CSV and ingestion test. Proposed times: Thu 09:00-11:00 PT or Fri 14:00-15:00 PT.

—Irene
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@finops.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding — evidence lifecycle and uploads

Thanks, Irene — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A couple quick confirmations from our side:

- Presigned links: 7-day expiry is acceptable. We will validate checksums during ingestion.
- Snapshot retention: FinOps requires 24 months of artifacts available in OneTrust for active review. We can accept your 3-snapshot model only if those three snapshots span the requested 24-month window (e.g., quarterly snapshots or an adjusted cadence). Would Redwood be able to publish quarterly historical snapshots to cover 24 months (8 snapshots) instead of three? If that is a hard constraint, we can explore hosting older snapshots in S3 with portal pointers, but preference is direct portal availability for e-discovery.

We are good to run an ingestion test on Friday at 14:00 PT — can your automation generate a presigned PUT and a short manifest with checksums for one test file?

If Friday works, Samir and I will join the call and confirm the import. Thanks for looping Marissa for any contract-side changes (if retention beyond 3 snapshots affects storage billing).

Best,
Lisa
Security Programs Lead, FinOps Inc
